dedupe_keys.name: transit on time performance data archive

description: Winnipeg Transit publishes an index of archived stop-departure punctuality files. Index fields give file URLs, start and end dates, size, row count, archive type and date added. The described observations include scheduled departures and deviation in seconds, with negative values meaning late and positive values meaning early. These historical files can supply calibration evidence for transit service simulation. The provider warns of missing transmissions and GPS or other errors in the onboard records. A separate recent dataset covers the latest month. The index is not itself an event table, and its files were not downloaded. Historical coverage, file usability and overlap with the recent dataset remain unverified. Coverage follows the provider-described Winnipeg system. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The standard licence field names the Canada Open Government Licence, while custom metadata names the Winnipeg licence. Their equivalence is unverified. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related Winnipeg Transit GTFS describes scheduled service.
